CREATE OR REPLACE EDITIONABLE FUNCTION "%USER_NAME%"."SESSIONS_THIS_MONTH" (p_case_number IN NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS l_num_sessions NUMBER; BEGIN select count(*) into l_num_sessions from sessions where 1 = 1 and trunc(date_session, 'month') = trunc(sysdate, 'month') and case_number = p_case_number and activity != 10;
RETURN l_num_sessions; END sessions_this_month; /
